legal_name: Pragati Facility & Manpower Services Pvt Ltd
note_revenue: Gross billing is ~Rs 1.1 cr a month including GST. What Pragati actually keeps is the service charge, roughly Rs 5.6 lakh — about 5% of billed value and 6-7% of the wage base. Everything else is pass-through: wages, PF, ESI and GST. This is why a delayed invoice is dangerous out of proportion to the margin at stake.
client_mix: Three anchor clients (Meridian, Yogita, Teamlease) are 193 heads and ~52% of billing. The remaining 17 clients are 307 heads at ~Rs 17,000 billed per head per month — smaller, housekeeping-heavy deployments at lower wage grades.
payroll_note: 500 workers are paid on the 7th of every month regardless of whether clients have paid. A disputed invoice is financed from the owner's OD limit.

team.name: Sunita Reddy
team.does: Prepares and sends all 20 invoices between the 1st and 5th. First responder to client objections. Primary user of the tool.

team.name: Ravi Prakash Shetty
team.does: Pulled in when a dispute is contentious or large. Approves credit notes. Signs off anything that reduces an invoice materially.
